questions.markdown: Obtain expressions for efficiency and ripple factor of bridge rectifier with ideal diodes. Consider a bridge rectifier employing 4 identical ideal diodes with primary voltage 120 V, 60 Hz. If the turns ratio of the transformer is 5:1, determine the average and rms value of load voltages.

A Si diode carries a reverse saturation current of 12 nA at $20^\circ$C operating temperature.
Find:

i) Diode current when it is forward biased by a voltage of 0.65 V.

ii) Diode current when the temperature rises to $100^\circ$C, using same forward bias voltage.
Given $V_Z = 6\ \text{V}$, $I_{Z\min} = 5\ \text{mA}$, $P_{Z\max} = 300\ \text{mW}$ and $R_S = 50\ \Omega$ for a Zener voltage regulator, find the range of load resistance for an input voltage 9 V.

With a neat circuit diagram, explain the working principle of self-bias circuit using MOSFET. Consider a self-bias circuit using MOSFET with $R_1 = 5\text{K}\Omega$, $R_2 = 12\text{K}\Omega$, $R_S = 1\text{K}\Omega$ and $V_{DD} = 1.8\ \text{V}$. Determine the bias current by assuming $V_{TH} = 0.5\ \text{V}$, $\mu_n C_{ox} = 100\mu\text{A}/\text{V}^2$ and $W/L = 4/0.18$. Also, determine the maximum allowable value of drain resistance ($R_D$) that can maintain MOSFET in saturation region.
Draw the structure of MOSFET and explain its operation. Also, with a neat diagram, explain the channel pinch-off phenomenon in MOSFET
Design a square wave generator to generate a signal of 1KHz with peak amplitude 12V.

With the help of a neat circuit diagram and relevant mathematical expressions, explain how an OPAMP can be used as a subtractor. Design an OPAMP difference amplifier circuit to obtain $V_{out} = 2\,(V_2 - V_1)$, where $V_2$ and $V_1$ are the inputs.

Consider a message encrypted as "1011001" using 7-bit even parity Hamming code and transmitted through a noisy channel. Decode the message, assuming a single bit error in the encrypted message received.

Simplify the given Boolean expression using K-Map and implement the simplified expression using NAND gates only

$$
F(A,B,C,D) = \Sigma m(1,3,6,7,9,12,15) + d(5,11,14)
$$

i) Using Boolean algebra rules, show that:

$$
(A+B)(A+\bar{C}) + \bar{A}\bar{B} + \bar{A}\bar{C} = A + \bar{B} + \bar{C}
$$

ii) Design a half adder using basic gates.

Design a 3-bit ripple up counter using positive edge-triggered T Flip-Flops.
Explain the working principle of SR flip-flop with neat circuit diagram and truth table.
Implement the function $F(A,B)=\Sigma m(0,2,3)$ using a 4:1 multiplexer.
